bearerAuth.description: OAuth access token of the consumer

parameters.name: id
parameters.description:
Filter by ID
Example: `id=5992f328ce593000ef000008`

parameters.name: created_at
parameters.description: Filter records by created date using times in ISO8601 format (Example: `2017-01-01T00:00:00-00:00`) or Unix timestamps (Example: `1483228800`) **Note**: Range filters can be applied by adding a suffix: ‘.gt’, ‘.gte’, ‘.lt’, ‘lte’ (Example: `created_at.gte`)

parameters.name: updated_at
parameters.description: Filter records by updated at date using times in ISO8601 format (Example: `2017-01-01T00:00:00-00:00`) or Unix timestamps (Example: `1483228800`) **Note**: Range filters can be applied by adding a suffix: ‘.gt’, ‘.gte’, ‘.lt’, ‘lte’ (Example: `updated_at.gte`)

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Filter by keyword

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Filter by ascending or descending order

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort on the specified field

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number to return, with per_page dictating page size

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Number of records to return per page

parameters.name: braintree_id
parameters.description: Filter by the consumer's Braintree ID

parameters.name: recurly_code
parameters.description: Filter by the consumer's Recurly Code

parameters.name: stripe_id
parameters.description: Filter by the consumer's Stripe ID

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Filter by the consumer's email

parameters.name: password_token
parameters.description: Filter by the consumer's password token

parameters.name: rss_token
parameters.description: Filter by the consumer's RSS token

parameters.name: pass_count
parameters.description:
Filter consumers by the number of pass plans that have been purchased or redeemed.
*Note*: Range filters can be applied by adding a suffix: ‘.gt’, ‘.gte’, ‘.lt’, ‘lte’ (Example: pass_count.gte = 1)

parameters.name: playlist_count
parameters.description:
Filter consumers by the number of playlists they are entitled to watch via purchase or pass plan.
*Note*: Range filters can be applied by adding a suffix: ‘.gt’, ‘.gte’, ‘.lt’, ‘lte’ (Example: playlist_count.gte = 1)

parameters.name: remember_token
parameters.description: The password token to use during remember login workflows

parameters.name: sign_in_count
parameters.description:
Filter consumers by the number of times they have signed in.
*Note*: Range filters can be applied by adding a suffix: ‘.gt’, ‘.gte’, ‘.lt’, ‘lte’ (Example: sign_in_count.gte)

parameters.name: last_sign_in_at
parameters.description: Filter records by last_sign_in_at using times in ISO8601 format (Example: `2017-01-01T00:00:00-00:00`) or Unix timestamps (Example: `1483228800`) **Note**: Range filters can be applied by adding a suffix: ‘.gt’, ‘.gte’, ‘.lt’, ‘lte’ (Example: `last_sign_in_at.gte`)

parameters.name: current_sign_in_at
parameters.description: Filter records by current_sign_in_at using times in ISO8601 format (Example: `2017-01-01T00:00:00-00:00`) or Unix timestamps (Example: `1483228800`) **Note**: Range filters can be applied by adding a suffix: ‘.gt’, ‘.gte’, ‘.lt’, ‘lte’ (Example: `current_sign_in_at.gte`)

parameters.name: terms
parameters.description: Boolean field to indicate if the consumer has agreed to terms and conditions

parameters.name: updates
parameters.description: Boolean field to indicate if the consumer has agreed to receive updates

parameters.name: video_count
parameters.description:
Filter records by video count
*Note*: Range filters can be applied by adding a suffix: ‘.gt’, ‘.gte’, ‘.lt’, ‘lte’ (Example: video_count.gte = 3)

parameters.name: transaction_count
parameters.description:
Filter consumers by their number of transactions.
*Note*: Range filters can be applied by adding a suffix: ‘.gt’, ‘.gte’, ‘.lt’, ‘lte’ (Example: transaction.gte = 3)

parameters.name: payment_provider
parameters.description: Filter records by payment provider.

parameters.name: custom
parameters.description: Filter records by custom attribues + Example: custom[weight]=100
